native_comparison.reference: Apple M1 iMac / Metal / 1920x1080 physical pixels
required_evidence: exact clean revision and binary hash
full physical gameplay recording with image/audio human review
matched same-route CPU/GPU/presented interval raw samples and warmup definition
median/p95/max, missed target intervals, scene/GPU memory and draw counts
both pre/post completion and backend failure/retry comparisons

backend_fallback: Mark Hall/identity/ranking/ceremony/unlock/revisit blocked; never synthesize a successful completion or production account service. Scout-only portable checks remain available.

cases.invariant: Cockpit approach admits assist below the unchanged 20m/s gate and completes landing.
cases.native_protocol: Capture standing/seated console and lower glazing during takeoff, coast, approach and landed states; inspect speed/thrust/assist text at 1080p, normal input and focus loss. Coordinate #498/#502.

cases.invariant: Power loss preserves inertial flight, held physical items and restoration state.
cases.native_protocol: Record powered/unpowered cabin, console, Core, Fabricator, tool and cargo; physically restart Core and verify readable blackout feedback. Coordinate #451/#489.

cases.invariant: Archive terminal is physically targeted, with no remote exterior or back-panel activation.
cases.native_protocol: Walk cabin and exterior, look at front/back of terminal; verify E prompt, reach and physical readability. Capture door/ramp clearance and return path.

cases.invariant: Archive read progress survives save/relaunch; temporary modal input does not.
cases.native_protocol: Read ordinary/damaged records through physical input, save, close and reopen. Verify record identities/read state, focus, scrolling and no remote actions.

cases.invariant: Archive modal input closes on pause, focus, power and range loss.
cases.native_protocol: Use E and navigation keys, change focus/escape/range/power; verify no held world action leaks and accessibility text remains usable.

cases.invariant: New-run Archive keeps unknown times, historical mentions and uncharted destinations distinct; no Hall/wormhole spoilers.
cases.native_protocol: Review all seven initial records at 1080p. Separate received claims, ship telemetry, personal notes and unknowns; Earth/Mars history must not become a navigable destination. This does not cover future menus.

cases.invariant: Mining, carrying, physical Fabricator/Core intake, installed module and paid recovery compose through production authority.
cases.native_protocol: Walk and time the entire mine-carry-ramp-intake-Fabricator-install-Core-recover loop without placements. Existing CPU test uses fixture deposits/poses; reference native route remains #515/#496.

cases.invariant: Recovery consumes actual Core surplus and stops at emergency reserve without refund or free progress.
cases.native_protocol: Observe progress/power under insufficient Core, emergency reserve, queue loads and stop/resume. Inspect machinery feedback and audible quiet/restoration transitions.

cases.invariant: Recovery save/restore, pause and native reader commands neither replay paid work nor bank offline progress.
cases.native_protocol: Checkpoint/relaunch during partial work and blackout; verify exact paid progress, no offline work, and fresh input after resume. Coordinate #515.

cases.invariant: Audio observes Core/recovery/pause without changing machine authority.
cases.native_protocol: Listen with reference speakers/headphones: quiet exterior/interior, spatial Core/Fabricator, alerts, mute/accessibility, focus/pause and stream continuity. Capture matched audio-on/off CPU/GPU frame costs; #485.

cases.invariant: Journey distance counts physical travel while excluding offline time, teleports and tours.
cases.native_protocol: Record local walking/EVA/ship travel and save/relaunch telemetry. This is existing local distance accounting, not future great-circle/wormhole policy or backend ranking verification.

cases.invariant: Doorway and EVA frame crossings do not invent coordinate-jump travel.
cases.native_protocol: Walk boarding ramp/door both ways, carry/drop fragments, leave moving ship and return. Observe collisions/contact, cargo and distance; retain physical-input video and raw timings.

cases.invariant: Awaken outside familiar landed Scout on permanent alien world >=30ly from Earth, practical competence retained, autobiographical/landing memory unknown.
cases.native_protocol: One-hour voluntary first-person opening on integrated Vesper: exterior silence to warm cabin, ordinary Archive discovery, first recovery resource loop. No Earth spawn, forced quest spam or unsupported landing explanation.

cases.invariant: Earth is remembered as home but uncharted; canonical catalog, names and old Archive entries never grant routes.
cases.native_protocol: Inspect fresh chart, scanner, search and saved routes. Observe/contact/identify/verify with provenance/epoch/uncertainty and restore. No hidden Earth/Solar System autocomplete or marker.

cases.invariant: Recover distress location before separate distant warning origin; received claims, observations and hypotheses remain distinct.
cases.native_protocol: Recover both packets, save/relaunch and revisit original records/sites. Verify separate source identities and unknown sender/time where appropriate. Do not invent later canonical revelations or call every damaged segment encryption.

cases.invariant: Actual wormhole entry, shortcut truth, warning truth and missing chronology stay unresolved; wormhole and Absenat gate remain distinct.
cases.native_protocol: Review recovered messages, prompts, tutorials, achievements, narration, accessibility and jump presentation. Never assert traveler traversed a wormhole or automatically award Absenat coordinates.

cases.invariant: Charting Earth and investigating Absenat are independent voluntary goals with unrelated exploration and survival possible.
cases.native_protocol: Take each lead in either order, defer both and continue survival/flight. Verify no compulsory linear progression, fake autopilot or mandatory combat/NPC encounters.

cases.invariant: Before verified completion no Hall action, disabled slot, tooltip, loading hint, achievement, accessibility label or metadata preview is discoverable.
cases.native_protocol: Fresh/returning-uncompleted/dead/restarted/offline accounts: inspect every shipping menu and accessible tree. Internal developer Hall fixtures must be explicitly gated; portable Archive checks are only partial coverage.

cases.invariant: Gate ceremony uses safe circular monumental geometry, central blazing primordial Core and concentric rings, with readable player-friendly presentation.
cases.native_protocol: Capture full floor traversal at 1080p with effects/accessibility variants. Check no exterior wall/social feed, no glare hazard, signs/LOD, center composition and quiet sound. Native M1 timing independent of Linux.

cases.invariant: First completion has one temporary local blank inner-ring sign without ejecting canonical ranked signs.
cases.native_protocol: Complete an actual verified journey at rank below 40; compare canonical snapshot with local ceremony overlay before/after posting. No synthetic local registry can certify global behavior.

cases.invariant: Completion, inscription and permanent unlock are durable/idempotent and require real backend identity; retries and reloads cannot duplicate them.
cases.native_protocol: Fault-test network before/during/after server commit, duplicate requests, disconnect/relaunch, invalid/moderated content and account mismatch. Keep pending/error explicit; no local unlock/global memorial fallback.

cases.invariant: Only after accepted completion/submission does Visit the Hall of Absenat unlock permanently across new runs/death.
cases.native_protocol: Compare pre/post complete menus and accessibility; retry rejected/pending completion. Verify account-scoped persistence and unchanged active survival save on entry/exit.

cases.invariant: Rank uses greatest cumulative physical completed-run distance with authoritative discontinuity/tie/account rules; farther is nearer center.
cases.native_protocol: Use independent backend fixtures for actual great-circle/cumulative paths, discontinuities, ties, best completed runs and one visible sign/account. Keep original inscription on later journeys; pending tie/wormhole rules must be specified first.

cases.invariant: Ring capacity is 40+20*(r-1), placements snapshot-stable through each visit; concurrent completions update only on reentry.
cases.native_protocol: Test boundaries 40/41,100/101,180/181 with large registry and paginated/LOD signage. Freeze one visit version during concurrent rank changes; new visit refreshes, including own latest placement.

cases.invariant: Repeated visits allow reading/own-sign location without new inscription, new journey, save consumption or hidden data exposure.
cases.native_protocol: Revisit repeatedly with active save, terminal run, new game and account rename. Exercise stale/offline/page-error snapshots explicitly; immutable visit and independent journey state must survive.

cases.invariant: Core mystery, 18-hour Earth delivery message and cosmological Hall symbolism remain canon without invented literal Big Bang coordinates or entity explanation.
cases.native_protocol: Review narrative/art/audio wording against approved documents. Gate is fictional access to a universe boundary; ordinary ship Core and primordial Hall presence are distinct in scale; no developer hypothesis becomes revealed truth.
